edges.reason: transfer uses _msgSender() as the implicit from address.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for allowance accounting.
_transfer receives the caller-derived sender through transfer/transferFrom.
manualswap authorizes callers by comparing _msgSender() to _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorizes callers by comparing _msgSender() to _feeAddrWallet1.
onlyOwner modifier requires _owner == _msgSender() before renouncing ownership.
openTrading is onlyOwner, so the caller must equal the stored owner.
nonosquare is onlyOwner, gating blacklist writes on the caller address.
delBot is onlyOwner, gating blacklist removal on the caller address.
setCooldownEnabled is onlyOwner, gating the cooldown flag on the caller address.
cooldown[to] is written with block.timestamp plus 30 seconds, making timing user-manipulable.
_transfer compares cooldown[to] against block.timestamp to decide whether a buy is allowed.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline to the router.
block.timestamp is passed as the deadline to addLiquidityETH.
_transfer requires !bots[from] && !bots[to], so the blacklist controls who may trade.
The cooldown mapping state gates the buy branch of _transfer.
_maxTxAmount caps the buy amount accepted by _transfer.
The inSwap guard flag prevents nested swap execution from _transfer.
swapEnabled decides whether the automatic contract-balance swap runs.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from/to to detect buys and sells.
transfer calls _transfer to perform the balance movement.
transferFrom calls _transfer for the actual token movement.
_transfer ends by calling _tokenTransfer on the same from/to/amount.
_transfer conditionally calls swapTokensForEth when swapEnabled and not in a swap.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance after swapping.
swapTokensForEth reads the router state variable to build the swap path.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call.
The external DEX swap hands execution to a third-party contract, which can attempt to re-enter swapTokensForEth; the lockTheSwap guard mitigates this.
sendETHToFee performs the native ETH transfer to the fee wallet.
sendETHToFee uses the stored _feeAddrWallet2 as the transfer recipient.
The ETH value transfer forwards execution to a payable recipient that could re-enter the payout flow.
manualswap routes the contract balance through swapTokensForEth.
manualswap compares the caller against _feeAddrWallet1 for authorization.
manualsend forwards the contract ETH balance to sendETHToFee.
manualsend compares the caller against _feeAddrWallet1 for authorization.
openTrading stores the deployed router into uniswapV2Router.
openTrading stores the pair returned by createPair into uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading calls the factory createPair to deploy the liquidity pair.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH, forwarding the contract ETH balance.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true at the end of initialization.
openTrading enables swapEnabled for the automatic fee swap.
openTrading enables cooldownEnabled.
openTrading raises _maxTxAmount to the configured buy cap.
nonosquare writes true into the bots mapping for each supplied address.
nonosquare iterates the caller-supplied bots_ array.
delBot clears the bots flag for the given address.
delBot reads its notbot parameter to index the blacklist.
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard.
The tAmount parameter drives the SafeMath-based r/t value computation in _transferStandard.
_transferStandard calls _getValues to derive all amount components.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam with the team fee amount.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee with the reflection fee amount.
_transferStandard subtracts rAmount from and adds rTransferAmount to _rOwned.
_takeTeam credits rTeam to the contract entry of _rOwned.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by rFee, permanently changing the reflection rate.
_reflectFee accumulates the nominal fee in _tFeeTotal.
The currentRate local scales tTeam into rTeam inside _takeTeam.
_getValues uses currentRate to derive rAmount, rFee and rTransferAmount.
approve writes the allowance mapping through _approve.
The spender parameter is forwarded by approve into _approve.
setCooldownEnabled writes the onoff flag into cooldownEnabled.
The onoff parameter is the value stored by setCooldownEnabled.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to the zero address after the onlyOwner check.
The from parameter selects the debit side of _transfer.
The to parameter selects the credit side and the cooldown key in _transfer.
The amount parameter feeds the require(amount > 0) and maxTx comparisons in _transfer.
The recipient parameter is passed from transfer into _transfer.
The amount parameter is passed from transfer into _transfer.
The tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped in swapTokensForEth.
contractTokenBalance is computed in _transfer and handed to swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance gates the sendETHToFee payout inside _transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: from is purely the local sender parameter of _transfer.
to is purely the local recipient parameter of _transfer.
the amount parameter only carries value into _transfer.
recipient is the transient parameter of the public transfer function.
amount is the transient parameter forwarded by the public transfer function.
tAmount is the scoped input of _transferStandard's reflection math.
tokenAmount is the scoped input of the swap helper.
bots_ is the iteration array local to the blacklisting loop.
notbot is the scoped address argument of the un-blacklist function.
spender is the transient parameter of the approve entry point.
onoff is the scoped toggle value of the setter.
contractTokenBalance is a temporary computed inside _transfer before the swap call.
contractETHBalance is a temporary computed inside _transfer to gate the ETH payout.
currentRate is a derived rate temporary consumed by the team-fee credit.
